questions.question: Dr. Taki faces a disciplinary complaint. Dr. Touitou informs him about the procedure. According to Article 58, disciplinary action is exercised in the first instance before:
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 58 provides that disciplinary action is exercised in the first instance before the Regional Council to which the dentist belongs.' Dr. Taki: 'I will prepare my defense.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou examines an appeal against a registration decision. According to Article 8, the refusal decision can be appealed before:
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 8 provides that the refusal decision can be appealed before the National Council.' Dr. Taki: 'I will prepare my appeal file.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has been suspended for one month by the Regional Council. Dr. Touitou informs him that according to Article 56, this suspension may be suspended. What does suspension mean?
options: The sanction is not applied immediately
The sanction is reduced by half
The sanction is transformed into a warning
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Suspension means that the sanction is not applied immediately. It becomes enforceable if a new sanction occurs within 4 years.' Dr. Taki: 'I will be irreproachable.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou finds that the Regional Council cannot function normally. According to Article 53, what does the law provide?
options: The appointment of a commission of three members by the administration
The appointment of a provisional administrator by the Minister
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 53 provides that the administration appoints a commission composed of three eligible members.' Dr. Taki: 'I will propose my candidacy.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki wishes to contest a decision of the Regional Council. According to Article 8, within what timeframe must he appeal?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 8 sets the appeal deadline at thirty days from notification.' Dr. Taki: 'I will act quickly.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou sits on the National Council. According to Article 30, the National Council hears appeals against decisions of the Regional Councils regarding:
options: Discipline and registration with the order
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 30 provides that the National Council hears appeals in disciplinary matters and registration with the order.' Dr. Taki: 'I will prepare my appeal.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has been struck off from the register. Dr. Touitou explains the consequences. According to Article 57, definitive striking off entails:
options: A reprimand with entry in the file
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 57 provides that definitive striking off entails a definitive prohibition from practicing.' Dr. Taki: 'I will do everything to avoid this outcome.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must vote in the Regional Council elections. According to Article 20, what is the condition for voting?
options: Be up to date with dues
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 20 provides that voters are Moroccan dentists registered with the order and up to date with their dues.' Dr. Taki: 'I will check my situation.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has been summoned before the disciplinary council. According to Article 71, what are his rights during the procedure?
options: He can be assisted by a colleague or a lawyer
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 71 provides that the dentist can be assisted by a colleague or a lawyer.' Dr. Taki: 'I will be assisted.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou examines a registration request from a foreign dentist. According to Article 5, what condition must he fulfill?
options: Be a national of a country with a reciprocity agreement with Morocco
Have practiced 10 years in his country
Be married to a Moroccan woman
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 5 requires that the foreigner be a national of a State that has concluded a reciprocity agreement.' Dr. Taki: 'I will check the agreement.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki wonders about the functioning of the Regional Council. According to Article 52, what happens if the quorum is not reached?
options: A second meeting is convened 15 days later
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 52 provides that a second meeting is convened 15 days after, and the Council can deliberate regardless of the number present.' Dr. Taki: 'I will ensure the quorum.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must rule on a disciplinary fault. According to Article 54, what is considered a disciplinary fault?
options: Violation of the rules of honor and probity
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 54 considers as a fault the violation of the rules of honor, probity, and dignity of the profession.' Dr. Taki: 'I will respect these rules.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has been elected to the National Council. Dr. Touitou informs him that he cannot combine this with a function on the Regional Council. According to Article 22, why?
options: Because the law formally prohibits it
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 22 specifies that they cannot combine the functions of member of the National Council and Regional Council.' Dr. Taki: 'I will resign from the Regional Council.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou has been suspended with suspension. Dr. Taki asks about the conditions. According to Article 56, the suspended suspension becomes enforceable if the dentist is sanctioned again within a period of:
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 56 provides for a period of four years.' Dr. Taki: 'I will be very vigilant during this period.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has changed region. According to Article 10, how is the transfer of registration carried out?
options: By a request to the Regional Council of origin
By a request to the Regional Council of the new region
By a request to the National Council
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 10 provides that the change of professional domicile is carried out upon a request filed with the president of the competent Regional Council.' Dr. Taki: 'I will file my request.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must organize the Regional Council elections. According to Article 23, within what timeframe must candidacies be filed?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 23 stipulates that candidacies must be filed at least two months before the elections.' Dr. Taki: 'I will prepare my candidacy.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has received a disciplinary warning. According to Article 55, the warning may be accompanied by a fine. What is the amount of this fine?
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 55 provides for a fine of 5,000 to 10,000 DH.' Dr. Taki: 'I will pay the fine and learn my lesson.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou sits on the National Council. According to Article 28, ex-officio members sit on the National Council. How many are they and what is their origin?
options: 6 members: 2 from the State, 2 teachers, 2 military
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 28 provides for six ex-officio members: two from the State, two teacher-researchers, and two military.' Dr. Taki: 'I will get to know these members better.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has been suspended. Dr. Touitou reminds him that according to Article 55, the suspension cannot exceed:
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 55 provides that the suspension cannot exceed one month.' Dr. Taki: 'I will respect the sanction.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou observes a conflict within the Regional Council. According to Article 53, what does the law provide in case of dysfunction?
options: The appointment of a provisional commission
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 53 provides for the appointment of a commission composed of three eligible members.' Dr. Taki: 'I will propose my candidacy for the commission.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki wonders about the missions of the Order. According to Article 13, the Order gives its opinion on:
options: Draft laws and regulations concerning the profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 13 provides that the Order gives its opinion on draft laws and regulations concerning the profession.' Dr. Taki: 'I will follow these opinions.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must examine a registration request. According to Article 4, what are the conditions for registration as of right?
options: Be Moroccan and hold the required diploma
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 4 provides for registration as of right for Moroccan dentists holding the required diploma.' Dr. Taki: 'I meet all the conditions.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki has received a reprimand with entry in the file. According to Article 55, what are the consequences of this sanction?
options: The mention remains in the professional file
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 55 provides that the reprimand is entered in the professional file.' Dr. Taki: 'I will do everything to erase this mention.'

questions.question: Dr. Touitou must make an important decision at the Regional Council. According to Article 52, how are decisions made in the absence of a quorum?
options: The decision is submitted to the National Council
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Article 52 provides that a second meeting is convened 15 days after, and the Council can deliberate regardless of the number present.' Dr. Taki: 'I will ensure the presence of members.'

questions.question: Dr. Taki, after having handled several disciplinary disputes with Dr. Touitou, receives her congratulations. What is the next step for Dr. Taki?
options: Become an expert in disciplinary disputes
questions.explanation: Dr. Touitou explains: 'Mastery of disciplinary disputes is a valuable skill. Becoming an expert is the next step.' Dr. Taki: 'I will train in disputes management.'
